title: The Battle of Salamis
subject: The Battle of Salamis, September 480 BC: the Greek fleet led by Themistocles lures the much larger Persian fleet of Xerxes into the narrow strait between the island of Salamis and the mainland near Athens, and wins
angle: a trick and a narrow strait: the giant fleet that could not turn
notes: First film of the slate (films/director/SLATE.md), Sam's order of 22 Oct 2026: new stories through our process, free tools only. Show twice the moment the Persian ships jam in the strait. Xerxes watching from his throne on the shore is the glint of dark humour. Kid-safe: losses as numbers and fading ships, no drowning shown.
